source: Google Antigravity / Gemini CLI custom agents specification: https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/overview and https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/main/CHANGELOG.md; ~/.gemini/config/agents/ and .agents/agents/ frontmatter schema.

explicit_model.verified: Documented values flash, pro, or inherit in custom agent frontmatter.

reasoning_effort.verified: No per-agent reasoning effort frontmatter field is documented.

tool_allowlist.verified: Documented frontmatter field 'tools' allowlist: presence in the list grants capabilities.

tool_denylist.verified: Documented frontmatter field 'disallowedTools' explicitly restricting specific tools.

read_only_enforced.verified: Read-only is enforced by omitting write/edit tools (write_to_file, replace_file_content) from the tools allowlist.

scoped_hooks.verified: No per-agent hooks frontmatter field; relies on Python guard scripts.

subagent_flag.verified: Antigravity/Gemini agent frontmatter supports mainAgent: true for top-level agents and subagent: true for subagents.

main_thread.verified: Main agent behavior verified via Antigravity/Gemini agent specification.

delegate_scope.verified: Gemini does not support type-restricted delegation syntax inside tools allowlist; restrictions are hardware-enforced via PreToolUse hooks (gemini_subagent_guard.py).
